text.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ أَلَمْ نَشْرَحْ لَكَ صَدْرَكَ

translations.asad: HAVE WE NOT opened up thy heart,
translations.sahih: Did We not expand for you, [O Muhammad], your breast?

translations.asad: and lifted from thee the burden
translations.sahih: And We removed from you your burden

translations.asad: that had weighed so heavily on thy back?
translations.sahih: Which had weighed upon your back

translations.asad: And [have We not] raised thee high in dignity?
translations.sahih: And raised high for you your repute.

translations.asad: And, behold, with every hardship comes ease:
translations.sahih: For indeed, with hardship [will be] ease.

translations.asad: verily, with every hardship comes ease!
Hence, when thou art freed [from distress], remain steadfast,
translations.sahih: So when you have finished [your duties], then stand up [for worship].

translations.asad: and unto thy Sustainer turn with love.
translations.sahih: And to your Lord direct [your] longing.
